Extends an existing paid subscription by the chosen billing period. Creates a Razorpay order with payment_purpose=RENEWAL. On successful payment via verify-razorpay-payment, the subscription's end_date is extended by GREATEST(end_date, NOW()) + validityMonths. Allows renewal of active and expired subscriptions (expired within 30-day grace period). Blocks cancelled, refunded, transferred. Only the subscription owner can renew. Rate-limited to 10/hour per user.

ACTION - UPGRADE
Upgrades an existing paid subscription to a higher tier. Creates a Razorpay order with payment_purpose=UPGRADE. On successful payment via verify-razorpay-payment, the existing subscription's plan, start_date, and end_date are replaced with the new plan. No credit for remaining time on old plan (immediate switch). Only the subscription owner can upgrade. Blocks same-plan, downgrade, and target=FREE. Rate-limited to 10/hour per user.

cells.K: Request a refund on the current subscription payment. Two-phase: action=PREVIEW returns the calculated refund amount + policy (no side effects). action=REQUEST executes the refund via Razorpay and cancels the subscription immediately. Policy: within 24h of payment → 100% refund (no reason needed); after 24h → prorated by remaining days (reason min 10 chars required). Fully automated via Razorpay — no admin approval. cells.I: create-razorpay-order
cells.K: Creates a Razorpay order to start a new subscription on the caller's flat. Resolves the flat from the caller's profile, runs eligibility via can_subscribe RPC (caller must be a resident + primary owner of the flat + no active/trial subscription with a valid end_date may exist). Works for first-time purchases AND for flats whose previous subscription has ended (expired, cancelled, refunded, or transferred) — the old row is preserved as historical record and a fresh subscription row is created after payment. If an active subscription exists, returns 403 — the app must route the user to /manage-subscription-payment (RENEW or UPGRADE) instead. FREE plan is rejected — use /activate-free-plan. Order carries payment_purpose=NEW in notes; on successful payment, /verify-razorpay-payment creates the subscription.

cells.E: Payment Verification (post-checkout, all purposes: NEW, RENEWAL, UPGRADE)
cells.I: verify-razorpay-payment
cells.K: Primary activation path after Razorpay checkout. Verifies HMAC signature, fetches the payment from Razorpay to confirm captured, then branches on payment_purpose from order notes: NEW creates a fresh subscription; RENEWAL extends the existing subscription's end_date by GREATEST(end_date, NOW()) + validityMonths; UPGRADE replaces the plan on the existing subscription with new start_date/end_date. Idempotent — repeat calls return alreadyProcessed: true with the existing subscription. Inserts rows into SSP_Payment, SSP_Subscription, and SSP_Subscription_Payment
cells.P:
payment_purpose — new, renewal, upgrade 

UPGRADE (read from order notes, not request)

cells.E: Razorpay Async Events (backup activation path + refund handling)
cells.I: razorpay-webhook
cells.K: Receives asynchronous events from Razorpay. Verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature against RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, dedupes by event.id (or payment/refund ID) via SSP_Payment_Event.provider_event_id UNIQUE constraint, then processes by event type: payment.captured acts as backup activation (skips if client verify-razorpay-payment already linked the payment); payment.failed logs a warning; refund.processed marks the refund processed and cancels the subscription; refund.failed marks the refund failed. Always returns 200 (even on processing failure) so Razorpay doesn't retry indefinitely. Never callable by users.
